_about: English for the Serbian texts the live dictionaries of www.evolako.rs do not translate. Key = the i18n engine's key of the Serbian text: FNV-1a 32-bit (base36) of the whitespace-normalized text, with Evolako hashed as BlokVolt (site/prerender.py key_of; the build checks every key against its "sr"). The build uses an entry only where the live dictionaries have nothing (titles, meta and JSON-LD of the /en/ pages, texts left in Serbian), and ships all entries to the engine of the /en/ pages as its last dictionary. American English, plain product language; prices, numbers and units as in the Serbian text. Never: atest, discount, 24/7, Plug&Charge, "immediately" as a promise, savings percentages, surcharge amounts, or wording that says Evolako handles the paperwork (it provides templates).

n6f4o0.en: Paid per installation at market rates, paid site visits for assessments, and we supply the materials. Belgrade or Novi Sad. Apply through the form.
n6f4o0.sr: Plaćanje po ugradnji, po tržišnim cenama, plaćen izlazak na procenu, materijal obezbeđujemo mi. Beograd ili Novi Sad. Prijavi se preko forme.

otf0tw.en: With a referral code you get 2 more months of subscription free — 4 months for 0 RSD in total. Check your garage in half a minute and leave your contact.
otf0tw.sr: Uz kod preporuke dobijaš još 2 meseca pretplate besplatno, ukupno 4 meseca za 0 RSD. Proveri svoju garažu za pola minuta i ostavi kontakt.

ovp1t0.en: The charger goes on your meter, a MID meter measures consumption, and the tenant pays for electricity with the rent at the price on your bill. What to agree in writing and what to ask your accountant.
ovp1t0.sr: Punjač ide na vaše brojilo, MID brojilo meri potrošnju, a zakupac struju plaća uz kiriju po ceni sa vašeg računa. Šta dogovoriti pisano i šta pitati knjigovođu.

pe24p2.en: How much an ordinary socket charges, why long charging heats up old contacts and when you need a dedicated line with a reinforced socket or a wallbox.
pe24p2.sr: Koliko puni obična utičnica, zašto dugo punjenje greje stare kontakte i kada ti treba namenska linija sa pojačanom utičnicom ili wallbox.

qdjylr.en: A guest arrives in the evening and has a full battery by morning: an 11 kW wallbox with a MID meter at every spot, at public prices with VAT.
qdjylr.sr: Gost stiže uveče, a ujutru ima pun auto: wallbox 11 kW sa MID brojilom na svakom mestu, po javnim cenama sa PDV-om.

qt2ga3.en: EV chargers for hotels, garages, new builds, apartment buildings and businesses: a MID meter at every spot, power management and monthly billing. Public prices with VAT.
qt2ga3.sr: Punjači za hotele, garaže, novogradnju, stambene zgrade i firme: MID brojilo na svakom mestu, upravljanje snagom i mesečni obračun. Javne cene sa PDV-om.

rsm0io.en: From the first resident sign-ups to charging in the garage: a power assessment, templates and the assembly decision, installation and billing by MID meter. The project costs the building nothing.
rsm0io.sr: Od prvih prijava stanara do punjenja u garaži: procena snage, šabloni i odluka skupštine, ugradnja i obračun po MID brojilu. Zgradu projekat ne košta ništa.

umu582.en: Chargers in an apartment building's garage at no cost to the building: templates for the assembly, a MID meter at every spot, electricity with no markup. From 96.000 RSD per spot.
umu582.sr: Punjači u garaži stambene zgrade bez troška za zgradu: šabloni za skupštinu, MID brojilo na svakom mestu, struja bez marže. Od 96.000 RSD po mestu.

v068e3.en: A leased car goes back when the contract ends, but the charging spot stays. How a company plans the charger, the MID meter and billing independently of the car.
v068e3.sr: Auto na lizing se po isteku ugovora vraća, a mesto za punjenje ostaje. Kako firma planira punjač, MID brojilo i obračun nezavisno od automobila.

v0fxwp.en: How many charging spots a hotel needs, why 11 kW is enough for guests, how hotels in Serbia charge for charging and how the electricity is calculated.
v0fxwp.sr: Koliko mesta za punjenje treba hotelu, zašto je gostima dovoljno 11 kW, kako hoteli u Srbiji naplaćuju punjenje i kako se računa struja.

v39abc.en: EV chargers for new builds and developers

x8oqwp.en: A new-build garage ready for chargers: a cable route and a box at every spot, plus power management. For 40 spots, about 20.000–30.000 RSD per prepared spot.
x8oqwp.sr: Garaža u novogradnji spremna za punjače: trasa i kutija kod svakog mesta i upravljanje snagom. Za 40 mesta oko 20.000–30.000 RSD po pripremljenom mestu.

x9m7hu.en: For charging at home, 11 kW is enough: a 22 kW charger needs 32 A per phase, more than an apartment has, and most cars take 11 kW at most.
x9m7hu.sr: Za punjenje kod kuće dovoljno je 11 kW: punjač od 22 kW traži 32 A po fazi, više nego što stan ima, a većina auta prima najviše 11 kW.

xf8brf.en: A rough price for the whole property: charging spots, shared infrastructure and the subscription. Examples for a hotel, a garage, an apartment building and a new build, with VAT.
xf8brf.sr: Okvirna cena za ceo objekat: mesta za punjenje, zajednička infrastruktura i pretplata. Primeri za hotel, garažu, stambenu zgradu i novogradnju, sa PDV-om.

ymm3xi.en: Public EV chargers in Serbia on one map: fast DC and AC, network prices with date and source. Plus what charging at home costs, overnight.
ymm3xi.sr: Javni punjači za električni auto u Srbiji na jednoj mapi: brzi DC i AC, cene mreža sa datumom i izvorom. I koliko košta punjenje kod kuće, noću.

ys1cdd.en: A reinforced socket on a dedicated line, RCD protection (Type A + DC), a certified MID meter and basic installation next to the distribution board (up to 2 m of cable); document templates included. Cable to a spot farther away and any other work — quoted at the assessment, before work starts. All prices with VAT.
ys1cdd.sr: Pojačana utičnica na namenskoj liniji, FID zaštita (tip A + DC), sertifikovano MID brojilo i osnovna ugradnja pored razvodne table (do 2 m kabla); šabloni papira su uz to. Kabl do udaljenijeg mesta i ostali radovi — po proceni, pre početka radova. Sve sa PDV-om.

zertke.en: At 30–80 km a day, a car uses 180–480 kWh a month. The math by EPS zones and tariffs: what that costs at night and what it costs during the day.
zertke.sr: Za 30–80 km dnevno auto uzme 180–480 kWh mesečno. Računica po zonama i tarifama EPS-a: koliko to košta noću, a koliko danju.

zinna6.en: Legal counsel for partnerships and contracts — Evolako
zinna6.sr: Pravnik za saradnju i ugovore — Evolako

zs762h.en: Who pays for the electricity, what the building assembly decides, what it costs and what the subscription covers — straight answers to 28 questions about charging an electric car at home in an apartment building.
zs762h.sr: Ko plaća struju, šta kaže skupština, koliko košta i šta pokriva pretplata — otvoreni odgovori na 28 pitanja o kućnom punjenju električnog auta u zgradi.
